af_codes.meaning: the standard pipeline is absent or renamed on the template location — find-and-bind would fail silently (STOP); the U03 EMPTY-LISTING attack refuses under this code at exit 5
a present pipeline is missing a contract stage or carries an extra/renamed/out-of-order stage
a custom value holds a real-looking value (never-a-real-token)
a Convert and Flow field write or a Drive write does not read back byte-for-byte in the same job (S8; verify_after.py is the provision-time read-back prover)
an attack fixture tripped the OFFLINE self-test (enforced violation)

exit_codes.0: verified success — all checks PASS (also plan / dry-run / self-test)
exit_codes.1: unexpected error (top-level guard; never a secret leak)
exit_codes.2: STOP refusal — label NOT SET / non-pit- value / usage / a contract section missing / the standard pipeline ABSENT or RENAMED on the location / a drifted (location, name) config pair
exit_codes.3: HELD — Convert and Flow API unreachable incl. the Cloudflare edge 403 (CF error 1010); retryable, never mislabeled as a scope problem
exit_codes.4: self-test FAILED (AF-AE-*-ATTACK family, enforced violation) — a tamper never masquerades as exit 1
exit_codes.5: mismatch / fail-closed default — drift, extra or mutated keys, a real-looking custom value, the U03 EMPTY-LISTING attack, or a read-back mismatch after the rename PUT

fail_closed.note: the U03 EMPTY-LISTING attack is refused UP FRONT (AF-AE-TEMPLATE-PIPELINE-MISSING, STOP exit 2) — a location with nothing bound is never judged a clean read.
